summary: End-to-end tested the new Centralized Announcement Dashboard (backend + frontend). 17/17 pytest cases pass covering admin CRUD, validation, non-admin gate, audience targeting, dismiss persistence, read_count increments, board-only vs popup, and external blast fanout code path. Full UI walkthrough on preview URL executed admin compose (workers+VAs, in-app+popup), worker popup + persist-on-reload + board on /crew, VA popup + board on /va with correct audience filtering (workers-only ann NOT shown to VA), board-only flow (no popup) with unread badge + Mark-as-read (increments admin read_count), hide via toggle-active, and delete cascade. All UITEST test data + 18,194 orphaned notification docs + 1 blast_log cleaned up. Feature is production-ready.

minor.issue: Does NOT cascade-delete the associated db.notifications rows (kind=announcement, announcement_id=X). Deleting a big fanout announcement leaves ~2700 orphaned notification docs per delete. Not a blocker for this feature but will accumulate over time. Consider deleting notifications with matching announcement_id on DELETE, or a periodic sweep.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside WorkerLayout — pre-existing, unrelated to announcements. Silent (does not crash UI) but worth cleaning up.

verification_steps_all_passed: Admin sidebar has 'Announcements'; /ops/announcements renders compose form with every documented data-testid (title, body, audience-worker/va, channel-in_app/email/sms/push, popup-toggle, post-btn)
Admin POST → toast 'Announcement posted to 2708 people (2708 in-app)'; card in announcements-admin-list shows POPUP + VAS + WORKERS chips, 0/2708 read, Delivery: 2708 in-app
Worker login → announcement-popup dialog auto-opens with title+body; 'Got it' (announcement-popup-dismiss) closes it; reload does NOT re-show (persisted per user via dismissed_by)
Worker /crew shows announcements-board section with the item (title, date, chevron)
VA (va.demo) login → same popup appears (audience included VAs); dismiss works; /va shows board with the announcement

Board-only (popup=OFF): worker login does NOT auto-popup; board shows item with 'new' dot + unread-badge; expanding via announcement-toggle-{id} reveals body + announcement-mark-read-{id}; clicking Mark as read hides the button, drops the new dot, unread-badge disappears
Audience: 'UITEST workers only' visible on worker /crew, NOT visible on VA /va — audience filter works
Admin read_count increments correctly (0/2327 → 1/2327 after worker mark-as-read) via announcement-read-count-{id}
Admin toggle-active hides the announcement from user GET /api/announcements (verified via backend test) and shows 'HIDDEN' badge in admin card
Admin delete via announcement-delete-{id} (with window.confirm auto-accepted) removes the row; subsequent DELETE returns 404
External channel fanout: POST with channels=['in_app','email'] returns blast_id, creates blast_logs doc (email actual sends fail gracefully due to invalid Resend key in preview — expected)
Backend validation: empty audience → 422; empty channels → 422; non-admin (worker cookie) → 403; admin GET /api/announcements returns items=[] (role not targeted)
Notifications: db.notifications populated with kind='announcement' entries per recipient at post time (18,194 UITEST notifications created and cleaned across the run)
action_items: Consider cascade-deleting db.notifications rows on DELETE /api/admin/announcements/{id} (or a sweeper) to avoid leaving thousands of orphaned notification docs after admins prune announcements
Pre-existing (not this feature): fix WorkerLayout hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') — no user-visible impact but noisy in console
critical_code_review_comments: routes/announcements.py: clean, single-file 235 LOC, well-structured; recipients query is bounded at 5000 which is a soft cap the real user base (~2708) fits under — flag if user base grows beyond 5k, that limit must be paginated or removed
Delete endpoint does not clean up related db.notifications rows (see minor issue). Also does not cancel in-flight fanout_blast_channels task — low risk since it runs to completion in background
AnnouncementsBoard.jsx: mark-as-read button only appears when the item is expanded — this is fine UX but worth documenting for testers (was initial cause of confusion in the playwright run)
AdminAnnouncements.jsx uses window.confirm for delete confirmation — consider a shadcn AlertDialog for a11y + consistency with the rest of the ops console

Notification bell / user-facing /api/notifications list endpoint verification was skipped by HTTP tests because the reachable endpoints weren't discovered — main agent's curl chain confirmed insert_many is done directly, so DB path is verified even without a bell endpoint check

Final DB state: 0 leftover UITEST rows across announcements/notifications/blast_logs. Admin announcements page shows 'No announcements yet.'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Announcements feature (iter54) is complete and green. If revisiting, use test_iter54_announcements.py as regression. Note: DELETE does NOT cascade to db.notifications — any regression test should either clean up manually or accept notification accumulation.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause. The one minor gap (orphaned notification docs on delete) is a design decision to flag, not a defect.
